Uses inventory_has because mining gray_terracotta with the provided iron pickaxe drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. Gray terracotta is at spawn-relative (4-7, 0-3, 8), directly behind the green terracotta structure. Without a pickaxe terracotta wouldn't drop, but the scene provides an iron pickaxe.

scene_description: A flat grass platform with two distinct structures on opposite sides of spawn. To the northeast (+X, +Z), a green terracotta pyramid (4x4 base, 3 blocks tall) with a gray terracotta wall directly behind it. To the southwest (-X, -Z), a brick slab platform (4x4 base, 2 blocks tall) with a polished diorite stairs column beside it. Player is given an iron pickaxe to mine blocks.
task_text: Explore the area to find the green terracotta structure, then mine the gray terracotta behind it. Also find the brick slab platform and mine the polished diorite stairs next to it.
design_notes: Two structures placed on opposite sides of spawn (~8 blocks away each). Green terracotta pyramid at (+4 to +7, 0-3, +4 to +7) with gray terracotta wall at (+4 to +7, 0-3, +8). Brick slab platform at (-7 to -4, 0-2, -4 to -7) with polished diorite stairs column at (-8, 0-3, -4 to -6). The gray terracotta is positioned directly behind the green terracotta so the dependency (find green → mine gray) makes spatial sense. Similarly, polished diorite stairs are beside brick slabs. Iron pickaxe provided for mining.
